recommended_action: Validate inputs (oi>=0, 0<iv<cap, T>0, lot>0, boolean option type, weights in [-1,1], required columns) and return NaN or raise when the chain is invalid; use sum(skipna=False) for net GEX; return NaN walls for zero OI
